# Cliffco Reverse Mortgage — Julian Giaquinto

> Reverse mortgage (HECM) lending for homeowners 62 and older on Long Island
> and throughout New York, from Cliffco Mortgage Bankers (corporate NMLS
> #65328), a 36-year independent mortgage banker headquartered in Uniondale,
> NY. Loan officer Julian Giaquinto (NMLS #56473) specializes in reverse
> mortgages: HECM and proprietary programs, lump sum, monthly payments, or
> line of credit. Borrowers retain title to their home.

## Pages

- [Reverse Mortgages on Long Island](https://cliffco-reverse-microsite.vercel.app/long-island/): Main overview, benefits, process, FAQ
- [How a HECM Works](https://cliffco-reverse-microsite.vercel.app/how-hecm-works/): Eligibility, payout options, borrower obligations

## Key facts

- Loan officer: Julian Giaquinto, NMLS #56473
- Corporate NMLS: 65328 (verify at https://nmlsconsumeraccess.org/EntityDetails.aspx/COMPANY/65328)
- Minimum borrower age: 62; borrower retains title; HUD-approved counseling required
- Main corporate site: https://cliffcomortgage.com/
